name: firefox-profile-jump
title: Firefox Profile Jump
author: jussi.vesa@gmail.com
description: Switch to the Firefox window of a given profile. Map a short display name to the exact Firefox profile name that Firefox shows in the window title.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

commands.name: jump-to-profile
commands.title: Jump to Firefox Profile
commands.subtitle: Select a profile window
commands.description: Select a configured Firefox profile and bring its window to the front.

commands.name: jump-to-profile-by-name
commands.title: Jump to Firefox Profile by Name
commands.subtitle: Type a display name
commands.description: Bring the Firefox window of one profile to the front. Assign a hotkey to a Quicklink of this command to get one hotkey per profile.

commands.name: refresh-window-cache
commands.title: Refresh Firefox Window Cache
commands.subtitle: Keeps the jump instant
commands.description: Read the Firefox windows and store which process serves each profile. Raycast also runs this every 10 minutes in the background, so that a jump by name needs no window read.

commands.name: manage-profiles
commands.title: Manage Firefox Profiles
commands.subtitle: Add, edit, or delete mappings
commands.description: Map a display name to the exact Firefox profile name. Detect the profiles of running Firefox windows.

preferences.name: profiles_seed
preferences.title: Seed Profile Mappings (optional)
preferences.description: Initial mappings. Use one 'Display Name = Exact Profile Name' per line, or a JSON array of { displayName, profileName, profilePath }. Read only while no mappings are stored yet.

preferences.name: process_name
preferences.title: Firefox Process Name
preferences.description: Name of the Firefox process as macOS reports it. Change this only for a non-standard build.

preferences.name: title_separator
preferences.title: Window Title Separator
preferences.description: Character that Firefox puts between the parts of the window title. Firefox uses an em dash.

preferences.name: title_suffixes
preferences.title: Window Title Suffixes
preferences.description: Comma-separated title parts that are not a profile name. Firefox appends these after the profile name. Translate them if your Firefox is not in English.
